hooks.command: f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath'); case "$f" in */backend/app/schemas.py) (cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/backend" && .venv/bin/python -m app.export_openapi ../frontend/src/generated/openapi.json && cd ../frontend && npm run -s gen:api) >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo '{"systemMessage": "Schema changed: regenerated frontend/src/generated (openapi.json, api.ts)"}' || echo '{"systemMessage": "Schema changed but regenerating the API types FAILED: run the steps in README (Changing the data model)"}' ;; esac
